entities.name: Query 197 aa dITPase
observations: Sequence length is 197 aa; predicted molecular weight 20.37 kDa and theoretical pI 4.77.
Has 46.1–49.0% identity over 95.4–98.5% coverage to reviewed bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases.
Homology supports EC 3.6.1.66, a Mg2+-dependent nucleoside-triphosphate pyrophosphatase.
Exact substrate preference is inferred from homologs rather than directly experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: Q9S2H9
observations: Reviewed Streptomyces coelicolor dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase; 49.0% identity and 95.4% query coverage to the query sequence.
Catalyzes hydrolysis of XTP, dITP, and ITP to the corresponding monophosphate and diphosphate; binds one Mg2+ per subunit.

entities.name: Noncanonical purine NTP pyrophosphatase reaction
observations: XTP + H2O -> XMP + diphosphate + H+ (Rhea RHEA:28610).
dITP + H2O -> dIMP + diphosphate + H+ (Rhea RHEA:28342).
ITP + H2O -> IMP + diphosphate + H+ (Rhea RHEA:29399).

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Reviewed homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit for the pyrophosphatase reaction.
